## Evidence and decisions

- [ ] Every proposal has a human-reviewed decision and rationale.
- [ ] `data/governance/proposal_outcomes.csv` records or updates every issue.
- [ ] Identity, mapping, hierarchy, and deprecation claims follow existing evidence rules.
- [ ] Unresolved cases remain explicit holds.

## Validation

- [ ] Collision, duplicate-ID, dangling-target, and cycle gates pass where applicable.
- [ ] Deterministic rebuild and repository validators pass.
- [ ] Skosmos representative cards were inspected after an empty-store reload where semantic output changes.
- [ ] Release tag remains blank until implementation enters a versioned release.
